tasks.short: Direct junior engineers and CAD technicians on water designs.

steps.what: Read the junior engineer's questions and marked drawings.

loop.input: Marked drawings and the junior's questions
loop.output: Question list with drawing reference and asked point
loop.check: Engineer checks each question against the drawing
loop.stop: One pass; a question with no drawing reference stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Questions sit in notes and sketch marks, not in a fixed form

steps.what: Decide which technical direction the junior should follow.
Supervise the CAD technician while the model is corrected.
Write the direction note and file the checked version.

loop.input: Spoken direction and the correction marks
loop.output: Direction note with the instruction and the drawing reference
loop.check: Engineer edits every instruction before the note is filed
loop.stop: One draft; an instruction that was not said is deleted
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must follow what was said, which is not a form

steps.what: CAD technician revises the model from the direction note.

tasks.design: Open questions and marked drawings sit on the {PROJECT} board, with the files in {DOCS}. The water engineer still directs the junior engineer and the CAD technician in person. A direction note is drafted from that talk and filed only after the engineer checks every instruction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Direction lived in desk talks and marked prints, so the instruction was retyped after every review.
tasks.enabler_now: The drawing file and the question list are enough to draft the note. The talk itself does not move.
tasks.still_hard: Judging which correction is safe when the junior's layout and the permit disagree.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer hears what the junior actually understood and stops a correction that only looks tidy.
tasks.altitude: Direction talks stay on the day. The engineer can refuse to file a note that does not match what was said.

reach.task: Revise a water drawing from marked comments
reach.learn: Which marks the drafter cannot read without a second talk

evidence.claim: Requirements and verification can sit in a register without a model writing the direction.
The signing engineer stays responsible for the direction that is filed.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from a junior's question or marked drawing to a filed direction note. Designing the plant is out of scope.
Test the {PROJECT} task fields and {DOCS} templates before any custom code.
Structured fields are drawing reference, asked point, instruction and date. The junior engineer produces the question. Fallback: the engineer types any blank line.
Live supervision is not replaced by the note.
unknowns: Whether juniors already file questions on the project board or only by mail.
Who else may change a filed direction note.
research_questions: Which direction notes are later treated as a change to the issued design?

already_counted.description: Checking the drafted direction note against what was said
Reading questions the extract left unclear

incremental.description: Keep the direction-note fields aligned with the drawing register
CAD technician still revises the model after each note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Desk talks and live supervision stay. Saving is the first read of marked drawings and the first draft of the note. A disputed layout stays fully manual, so the low case keeps almost all of the review.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Critique water and wastewater treatment proposals and designs.

steps.what: Log incoming treatment proposals and the design files.
Extract flows and loads from the treatment proposals.

loop.output: Flow, load and stated permit limit fields
loop.check: Engineer compares each figure with the proposal page
loop.stop: One pass; a figure with no page reference is left blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Proposals mix tables and prose, so a fixed column map misses loads

steps.what: Run coded checks for clashes and missing treatment units.
Judge whether the treatment design meets the duty.
Discuss the critique with the proposing engineer.
Send the checked critique to the client.

loop.input: Duty judgement and the meeting notes
loop.output: Critique note listing each finding and the open point
loop.check: Engineer edits every finding before send
loop.stop: One draft; a finding that is not in the judgement is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must follow the judgement, which is not a fixed letter

tasks.design: A {WORKFLOW} log takes each treatment proposal, and a bounded read fills flows, loads and permit limits in {DOCS}. Coded checks flag clashes and missing units. The engineer judges the duty, then sends the critique only after checking the note.
tasks.previous_blocker: Proposals arrived as mixed files, so every load was retyped before a comment could be written.
tasks.enabler_now: The load fields and a rule set for units and clashes can be checked before the meeting. The duty judgement stays.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding whether a failed check is a real process risk or a modelling gap.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows which limit the client can actually change and which one would harm treatment.

ambition.what: Reject a proposal that fails a coded unit or clash check before the critique meeting, instead of finding it in the room.

tasks.altitude: Critique meetings stay. The engineer may refuse to send a note that still has a blank load or an unreviewed finding.

reach.task: Check structural capacity of process tanks and channels
reach.learn: Which wall and slab loads the critique must not quietly change

evidence.claim: Rule-based plan review can flag clashes and missing provisions before a person judges them.
A design check can flag a parameter or constraint breach, and a person still decides.
Safety components in water supply are treated as high-risk under the EU AI Act.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from a received treatment proposal to the critique sent to the client. Redesign of the plant is out of scope.
Test native model-check rules and {DOCS} properties before custom code.
Structured fields are average flow, peak flow, biochemical load, stated permit limit and unit list. The proposing engineer produces them. Fallback: the engineer types any blank figure.
A coded finding is not a decision. The duty judgement stays with the engineer.
unknowns: Whether proposals arrive as models, drawings or prose.
Which permit limits are already stored as fields.
research_questions: Which coded findings are false on this client's drawing standard?

already_counted.description: Judging findings the rules cannot close
Editing the critique note before send

incremental.description: Maintain the unit and clash rules when the permit template changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Standard proposals with complete load tables save the logging, the extract and the coded pass. Incomplete prose and the duty judgement stay manual. The meeting stays in every case, so the low end keeps most of the review.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design water or wastewater treatment plants and their process units.

steps.what: Gather influent data for the treatment plants.

loop.output: Basis sheet: flow, load, temperature and effluent limit
loop.check: Engineer checks each basis figure against the source page
loop.stop: One pass; a missing limit stays blank and blocks sizing
loop.why_not_simpler: Permits and lab reports do not share one table

steps.what: Choose the process train for reactors, membranes and basins.
Calculate aerobic digesters and sludge lagoon volumes.
Lay out headworks, lift stations and control buildings.
Size ultraviolet disinfection and surge overflow basins.
Drafter builds the plant drawings from the sketches.
Issue the treatment plant design for external review.

loop.input: Volume sheet, unit sizes and drawing list
loop.output: Issue transmittal naming the design version and open points
loop.check: Engineer checks every number against the volume sheet
loop.stop: One draft; a number not on the sheet is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The cover note must match this design version, not a previous letter

tasks.design: Permit and influent fields are stored on the {PROJECT} record. Volumes for digesters, lagoons, disinfection and basins are calculated in {SPREADSHEET} from those fields, while headworks, lift stations and buildings stay a layout the engineer draws. The issue set leaves only after the engineer checks that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each plant restated the permit into a fresh workbook, and the layout was redrawn before anyone could check a volume.
tasks.enabler_now: Basis fields and standard volume formulas can be calculated once the process train is chosen. Choosing the train and the layout stays.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a train when influent varies, and fitting headworks and buildings on a tight site.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides which unit can be smaller and which one would fail a wet-weather day.

ambition.what: Compare two process trains on the same basis sheet before the layout starts, instead of drawing only the first idea.

tasks.altitude: Plant design stays the core of the week. The engineer can hold an issue when a basis figure is blank or a volume does not match the sheet.

reach.task: Select pumps and blowers for the process units
reach.learn: The duty points the layout must leave room and power for

evidence.claim: Site-design tools can lay out earthwork from constraints, while the engineer still chooses the process train.
A solver can size a unit from a basis sheet; a prediction from past runs is not a checked design.
The signing engineer remains responsible for the issued design.
Safety components in water supply are treated as high-risk under the EU AI Act.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from influent and permit basis to the issued treatment-plant design. Construction supervision is out of scope.
Test native {SPREADSHEET} formulas and {PROJECT} fields before custom code.

Structured fields are average flow, peak flow, load, temperature, effluent limit, unit type and volume. The client or the lab produces the influent record. Fallback: the engineer types a blank basis figure and sizing waits.
Layout of headworks, lift stations and control buildings is not a document summary.
unknowns: Which volume formulas the firm already trusts.
Whether the drafter works in the same model as the engineer.
research_questions: Which units have no trusted formula and must stay a hand calculation?

already_counted.description: Checking issued numbers against the volume sheet
Reviewing the process-train choice against the basis

incremental.description: Update volume formulas when a permit limit definition changes
Drafter time to rebuild drawings after a layout change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A repeat industrial plant with a complete basis saves the extract and the volume pass. A first-of-kind train, the layout and the external issue check stay. The low case is a site with missing influent data.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate water system operation and maintenance for efficiency.

steps.what: Pull operation and maintenance readings from the plant system.
Trend flow, energy and chemical use against efficiency.
Walk the site and check how operators run the equipment.
Operator explains constraints the trends do not show.
Recommend efficiency changes and record the chosen ones.

tasks.design: A scheduled read from the {OPS_SYSTEM} loads flow, energy and chemical use into {BI}. The engineer still walks the site with the operator, because the trend does not show how the plant is run. The recommendation is filed only after the engineer confirms which changes were actually chosen.
tasks.previous_blocker: Readings were copied into a workbook by hand, so the visit started before a trustworthy trend existed.
tasks.enabler_now: Tag lists and a scheduled export make the trend. The walk and the choice of change stay.
tasks.still_hard: Telling a real loss from a meter fault, and from a constraint the operator cannot drop.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer sees workarounds on the plant that no export contains.

ambition.what: Review each plant's energy and chemical trend every month, and only then decide which efficiency change is worth a project.

tasks.altitude: Site walks stay. The engineer can decline a recommendation that is not tied to a trend point or a site note.

reach.task: Study how operators move and lift during a shift
reach.learn: Which efficiency idea would add walking, reaching or manual handling

evidence.claim: Operating trends belong on a dashboard; free-text failure notes still need a sample check.
Large sites have a recurring energy information duty, separate from a water-efficiency recommendation.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from plant readings to a signed efficiency recommendation. Capital design of a new unit is out of scope.
Test the {OPS_SYSTEM} export and a native {BI} view before custom code.
Structured fields are tag, timestamp, flow, energy and chemical mass. The plant system produces them. Fallback: the engineer enters a missing week by hand and marks it incomplete.
The site walk is not replaced by the trend.
unknowns: Which tags the plant system actually exports.
Whether chemical deliveries are masses or invoices.
research_questions: Which efficiency changes need a permit amendment before they can be recommended?

already_counted.description: Confirming the chosen changes against the trend and the site notes

incremental.description: Fix broken tags and refresh the trend definition

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A plant with stable tags saves the export and most of the trending. The walk, the operator's constraints and the choice of change stay. The low case is a month of missing or distrusted meters.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Design reviews, plant walks and direction of juniors stay on the week. The engineer signs what leaves the team and spends less time retyping figures already on the record.
reach: Civil engineers checking structural capacity of tanks and channels
Drafters revising drawings from a marked comment set
skills_to_grow: Turning permit limits into fields a check can read
Reading a coded clash result before trusting it
Giving direction from a marked drawing rather than a long mail thread
role.ambitious_version: The engineer can refuse a proposal that fails a coded duty check before the meeting, and can compare a plant's monthly energy and chemical use with its design basis.
